summary: Romance/social-engineering scam where a contact on X (“Elena”) lured the victim into a fake “IBM-EA arbitrage trading” platform showing fake profits and freezing funds to extort more deposits via a bogus bonus program
user_mistake: Sent ~$12–13k USDC; platform shows ~$17k but demands an additional $32k to unlock
prevention: Never send crypto to platforms promoted by online strangers / Profits and balances on scam sites are fake / Any request to pay more to withdraw is a scam / Ignore recovery offers; report to IC3
